memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: independent in ADLs, walks 30 min daily.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (negative).
falls: 0 falls last 12 mo; gait normal; TUG 9 s (normal).
medicines: 4 regular (silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD); loperamide 2 mg SOS.
mood: reports occasional irritability, denies depression.
carers: son, Rajesh, provides weekly grocery help.
goals: "I want to stay active and avoid hospital admissions."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
ALT 38 U/L (7‑35) slightly ↑; AST 30 U/L (8‑40) normal.
Platelet count 210 ×10⁹/L (150‑400) normal.
Lipids: Cholesterol 185 mg/dL (<200), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 102 mg/dL (<130), TG 138 mg/dL (<150).
CBC: Hb 13.8 g/dL (13‑17), WBC 6.2 ×10⁹/L (4‑10), Plt 210 ×10⁹/L.
Stool routine: ova nil, pus cells 0‑1/hpf.
tTG‑IgA <4 U/mL (negative).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
rosuvastatin 10 mg OD (increased from 5 mg OD).
Other medicines unchanged.
